title: Study firstmate work handling (M1) as the first milestone
summary: I read this as the first study milestone in BRIEF.md: firstmate's work-handling mechanism (M1), done end to end. That means reading firstmate's source, running it, modeling it, and publishing to Pages. The change capability can't do that, so I decline.
decline_reason: This asks for a study capability, not a repository edit. It means fetching and reading firstmate's source and prompts at a pinned SHA, running firstmate for real within spend caps, modeling work handling formally as data, and publishing the result to a Pages site. The change capability only edits files in this repository, and its verifier can only run cargo and git read commands. Writing a firstmate M1 document without the source would invent claims, which breaks the evidence default. A studying capability with network access, the ability to run external systems, and a verifier that can check claims against the source is needed.

defaults_applied.how: The request is short, so I recovered its meaning from BRIEF.md (S4 M1, the first-milestone sequencing) instead of asking.
A single focused change cannot hold a full milestone, and a milestone-sized change would be too big.
A study document needs cited sources and measured numbers, which cannot be checked without the firstmate source.

assumptions: 'firstmate' is github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate (BRIEF.md line 23) and 'M1' is the work-handling mechanism in BRIEF.md S4 (line 306).
The firstmate source is not in this repository, so a producer limited to editing repo files cannot read it or run it.
The first milestone (BRIEF.md line 395) needs a design, a build, independent verification and a live Pages site. That is more than one focused change.
question: Should I instead read this as a narrower change, such as a design doc under docs/design/ that plans the firstmate M1 study (method, pinned SHA, what to run, how to model it as data) without making claims about firstmate itself?
out_of_scope: Fetching or running firstmate or Hermes.
Building the explainer site or Pages deployment.
Studying M2 to M9 or the other instances.
departures: Declined, so there is no producer or verifier run. The cost and time cover only the reading and any handling of the decline.
